about.title: About Quests
about.subtitle: A senior team from global tech leaders, focused on results—not overhead.
about.missionText: Top tech firms often take only large projects and lock clients into rigid contracts. We started Quests to change that. You get the same caliber of expertise, with flexible terms and fast turnaround.
about.expertiseText: Engineers from AWS, Google, Microsoft, and other tech leaders work alongside consultants from the Big Four and other top firms. One team takes you from strategy to implementation, fast. Because engineering is our foundation, we don't stop at recommendations. We stay with you until your business has truly changed.

services.title: Our Services
services.subtitle: One partner for your entire IT journey: plan, build, run, and grow your team.

consulting.title: Strategy & Consulting
consulting.short: Align technology with your business goals—and get a clear roadmap to get there.
consulting.details: We assess your current systems, pinpoint what to fix first, and build a practical roadmap you can act on.

system.title: Cloud & AI Development
system.short: Custom systems built on modern cloud and AI. Secure, scalable, and ready to grow.
system.details: We design and build software that solves your specific challenges, combining deep engineering with a clear grasp of your business.

operations.title: Infrastructure Operations
operations.short: Keep your systems fast, secure, and always on—so you can focus on your business.
operations.details: We monitor, secure, and optimize your infrastructure around the clock—and plan for recovery before you need it.

training.title: Team Enablement
training.short: Build a team that can run and evolve your systems on its own.
training.details: Hands-on training and mentoring that transfers real skills, so your team owns its technology long after we leave.

material.title: AI-Accelerated Materials Research
material.short: 68% shorter research cycles for a leading materials lab, powered by machine learning.
material.challenge: The client had to test and validate new materials much faster to stay competitive.
material.solution: We built a machine learning model that predicts material properties from composition data, reducing the need for physical tests.
results: About $1.2M saved in annual testing costs

chatbot.title: Generative AI Customer Support
chatbot.short: 78% of inquiries resolved automatically for a global e-commerce company.
chatbot.challenge: Support volume and costs were climbing fast, putting service quality at risk.
chatbot.solution: We built a multi-channel generative AI assistant that handles routine questions and hands complex cases to human agents.

predictive.title: Predictive Maintenance with AI
predictive.short: 83% less unplanned downtime for a manufacturer, with ROI in 9 months.
predictive.challenge: Unexpected equipment failures and inefficient maintenance were causing major production losses.
predictive.solution: We connected IoT sensors to an AI model that detects warning signs and predicts failures before they happen.

dashboard.title: Executive Decision Dashboard
dashboard.short: From two-week reports to real-time insight for a multinational's leadership.
dashboard.challenge: Leaders at a multinational couldn't get timely, reliable data. It was scattered across disconnected systems.
dashboard.solution: We unified data from multiple sources into one dashboard that shows key metrics at a glance.
results: Higher data accuracy with no manual reporting

voice.title: Voice-Guided In-Store Navigation
voice.short: 64% faster product search with Alexa, rolled out to 87 stores.
voice.challenge: In a major retailer's large stores, customers struggled to find what they came for.
voice.solution: We built voice navigation on Amazon Alexa, connected to store inventory and indoor positioning.

legacy.title: Legacy System Modernization
legacy.short: 62% lower infrastructure costs by moving a financial firm's monolith to cloud microservices.
legacy.challenge: A financial services company's aging monolith was costly to maintain, hard to change, and couldn't keep up with growth.
legacy.solution: We migrated it step by step to microservices on AWS, so each service can scale and deploy independently.
